info.name: red-bank Backend
info.description: Postman collection for the API requests currently implemented in the red-bank backend. Public business APIs use gatewayBaseUrl and the shared context/data envelope. Internal APIs call their owning microservice directly with X-Internal-Service-Token. Debug endpoints require the develop profile and REDBANK_DEBUG_ENABLED=true. Gateway key exchange requires REDBANK_GATEWAY_APP_ENCRYPTION_ENABLED=true.

request.description: Conditional gateway endpoint. Enable REDBANK_GATEWAY_APP_ENCRYPTION_ENABLED=true before calling. clientPublicKey is Base64 X.509 X25519 public-key bytes. Encrypted API calls use X-Key-Exchange-Id, a Base64 12-byte X-Encryption-Nonce, and a Base64 AES-256-GCM request body.

Creates a user and returns a limited onboarding token. The collection test stores it as onboardingToken. location may be null/omitted. Optionally send the anonymous onboarding token to adopt the verified wizard phone and device (see Register (Onboarding Wizard)).

Wizard registration with the anonymous onboarding token: phoneNumber must equal the session's verified phone (BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION otherwise) and the verified device is adopted, so the next login from the same fingerprint needs no OTP. location is optional (null here). The collection test stores the limited token as onboardingToken.

Returns either a user token or a device verification challenge. The collection test stores challengeId as deviceChallengeId and the limited token as deviceVerifyToken. Send data.reason=REGISTER with null credentials to start an anonymous onboarding session instead (see Anonymous Onboarding Login).

Starts an anonymous onboarding session for the registration wizard: no credentials, short-lived token limited to ONBOARDING_PHONE_SET, ONBOARDING_DEVICE_VERIFY, and ONBOARDING_IAM_REGISTER. Returns accountCompletionStatus=ONBOARDING. The collection test stores the token as anonymousOnboardingToken. reason=RECOVERY is reserved and rejected with BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION.

Uses the login challenge token. In develop, otpCode=111111 works only when REDBANK_DEBUG_MOCK_OTP_ENABLED=true. Also accepts the phoneChallengeId from KYC Set Phone under the anonymous onboarding token (see Verify Onboarding Phone).

Verifies the phoneChallengeId created by KYC Set Phone under the anonymous onboarding token. context.device.fingerprint is required: on success the verified phone and fingerprint bind to the onboarding session and Register (Onboarding Wizard) adopts them. Returns deviceId=null, no new token, accountCompletionStatus=ONBOARDING. In develop, otpCode=111111 works only when REDBANK_DEBUG_MOCK_OTP_ENABLED=true.

request.description: Revokes the current USER bearer token in {{accessToken}} by writing its JWT jti to Redis until the token's original expiration. Run this after requests that still need {{accessToken}}; replaying the same token should return 401.
Creates the personal profile and default saving account. The collection test stores profileId, accountNumber, and iban.
Only succeeds when the ledger-backed balance is zero.
Reopens an owned closed account and reactivates the owning profile.
Creates an additional profile. The service currently limits users to five profiles.
Edits profile display name and image. Send image:null to clear the current profile image.
Lists cards owned by the authenticated user and selected profile, with optional status and account-number filters.
Lists active KYC jobs. This endpoint is public.

Creates a phone-verification OTP challenge for the anonymous onboarding session (delegated to iam-service). Requires the anonymous onboarding token; full user tokens are rejected. Returns challengeId, expiresAt, and resendAvailableAt (45s resend timer). Resends inside the cooldown and more than 5 challenges per phone per hour return LIMIT_EXCEEDED; an already registered phone returns CONFLICT. The collection test stores the challenge as phoneChallengeId.
Sets an immutable referral during onboarding.
Gets the authenticated user KYC and account-completion status.
Completes a KYC case using an admin or system token.
Lists runtime feature flags using an admin token.
Evaluates client-visible flags for the authenticated user. Subject fields must remain null for user calls.
Updates one feature flag and creates an audit record.
Reads the user overrides and ordered targeting rules for one flag.
Replaces and audits one flag's complete targeting configuration.
Lists transfer methods after applying runtime feature flags.
Creates one idempotent internal transfer. Change transferIdempotencyKey for a new transfer.
Lists unique successful recent transfer destinations.
Lists active PFM box presets through the API gateway.
Creates a vault-backed PFM box through the API gateway.
Lists the authenticated user's PFM boxes through the API gateway.
Updates owned PFM box display metadata through the API gateway.
Closes an owned, empty PFM box through the API gateway.
Lists ledger-backed transactions for an owned PFM box through the API gateway.

Internal endpoint normally called by kyc-service for POST /api/v1/kyc/phone/set. Creates a hashed phone-verification OTP challenge bound to the onboarding session (anonymous token subject). Uses a random onboardingSessionId here for direct testing; the wizard path goes through KYC Set Phone.

Internal endpoint iam-service calls during login/device-verify (after account-service reports KYC_REQUIRED) to resolve the KYC-derived completion status: KYC_REQUIRED / KYC_PENDING / COMPLETED. TODO(kyc-panel): with redbank.kyc.auto-approve-enabled=true (develop default), a user with no KYC case is auto-approved and returns COMPLETED.
